<a id="page-forms"></a>
# Buttons, forms and inputs

<a id="forms-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

Buttons, text fields, checkboxes, switches, radios, sliders, dropdowns, segmented buttons, date and time pickers,
chips and signatures: every control's props, **how to style each one (in one place, below)**, two-way binding to a
variable, validation and error states, focus and the keyboard.

<a id="forms-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

An email field stored in a variable on every change, an error shown after a failed send, and a thank-you after a
good one:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["contact"],
  "nodes": {
    "contact": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 500},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["email", "emailError", "send", "thanks"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 500}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"spacing": 8, "crossAxisAlignment": "start"}
    },
    "email": {
      "type": "textField",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 28}},
      "props": {"decoration": {"labelText": "Email", "hintText": "you@example.com"}, "keyboardType": "emailAddress"},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "changed"},
          "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "email", "value": "${result}"}]
        }
      ]
    },
    "emailError": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 18}},
      "props": {"text": "Enter a valid email address.", "style": {"fontSize": 13, "color": "#FFDC2626"}},
      "bind": {"visible": "${= tried && !contains(email, '@')}"}
    },
    "send": {
      "type": "elevatedButton",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": 44},
      "props": {"label": "Send"},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [
            {"type": "setVariable", "variable": "tried", "value": "true"},
            {
              "type": "if",
              "condition": {"left": "${= contains(email, '@')}", "op": "isTrue"},
              "then": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "sent", "value": "true"}]
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    "thanks": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "Thanks! We'll reply within a day.", "style": {"fontSize": 15, "color": "#FF16A34A"}},
      "bind": {"visible": "${sent}"}
    }
  },
  "variables": {
    "contact": [
      {"name": "email", "type": "text", "value": ""},
      {"name": "tried", "type": "boolean", "value": false},
      {"name": "sent", "type": "boolean", "value": false}
    ]
  }
}
```

<a id="forms-reference"></a>
## Reference

Every control's props, then the models that style them ([InputDecoration](#type-InputDecoration),
[InputBorder](#type-InputBorder), [ButtonStyle](#type-ButtonStyle)...), then the input triggers.

<a id="node-filledButton"></a>
### `filledButton`

Flutter `FilledButton`: the primary action, filled with the theme's `primary`. With nothing styled it is the default (SSUI) button on the control scale: 28 high when it hugs, its padding, font and icon sizes from its height (24, 28, 32, 36, 44). A bound "selected" shows a selected look.

`ElevatedButton`, `FilledButton`, `TextButton`, `OutlinedButton`: a label with an optional icon (their `.icon` constructors), styled by a `ButtonStyle`.

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | String | `""` |  | The button's text (not `text`). Its colour, size and weight are in `style`. |
| `textAlign` | [TextAlign](values.md#enum-TextAlign) | `"start"` | `left`, `right`, `center`, `justify`, `start`, `end` |  |
| `icon` | [IconData](values.md#type-IconData) | `{}` |  | The icon beside the label; empty for none. |
| `iconAlignment` | [IconAlignment](values.md#enum-IconAlignment) | `"start"` | `start`, `end` |  |
| `spacing` | double | `8` | ≥ 0 | Space between the icon and the label. |
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | False is a disabled button (`onPressed: null`). |
| `style` | [ButtonStyle](forms.md#type-ButtonStyle) | `{}` |  | The button's look (Flutter's `ButtonStyle`): `backgroundColor`, `foregroundColor` (the label and icon), `textStyle`, `shape`, `side`, `padding`. A button's colours are here, not in `decoration`. |
| `autofocus` | bool | `false` |  | Takes keyboard focus when it appears (Flutter's `autofocus`): Enter or Space presses it. |
| `loading` | bool | `false` |  | Busy (SSUI's `isLoading`; no Flutter counterpart): a spinner in place of the icon, taps ignored, drawn as disabled, announced as busy. Bind it to the state an action sets while it runs. |
| `tonal` | bool | `false` |  | `FilledButton.tonal`. |

<a id="node-textField"></a>
### `textField`

Flutter `TextField`. Leave its height to hug: every input (text field, dropdown, date and time picker) is then the same control height (28); a fixed height picks another step of the control scale (24, 28, 32, 36, 44) and should be the same on the inputs beside it.

Flutter `TextField` (a `TextFormField` when it validates).

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `initialValue` | String | `""` |  | The text it starts with (`TextFormField.initialValue`). |
| `decoration` | [InputDecoration](forms.md#type-InputDecoration) | `{}` |  | The field's label, hint, helper and error texts, border (per state), fill, padding and icons (Flutter's `InputDecoration`). |
| `style` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` |  | The typed text's style; unset is the theme's. |

Flutter `Switch`, scaled to its box (59 px wide is Flutter's own size).

<a id="behavior-form"></a>
### `form` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [FormBehavior](forms.md#type-FormBehavior). Default: unset.

Flutter's Form: the text fields inside validate together (the validate action); its nodes read ${form.valid} and ${form.errors}.

<a id="type-FormBehavior"></a>
#### FormBehavior

Flutter's `Form`: the text fields inside the node are one form. The `validate` action (`FormState.validate()`) checks them all with their validators, shows each one's error and focuses the first invalid field; `autovalidateMode` makes them check themselves too, as each field's own `autovalidateMode` does. The node and the nodes inside it read `${form.valid}` (every field passes its validator now) and `${form.errors}` (the errors the fields show, in order: `{field, label, message}`), for a summary. JSON `true` or `{"autovalidateMode": ...}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `autovalidateMode` | [AutovalidateMode](values.md#enum-AutovalidateMode) | `"disabled"` | `disabled`, `always`, `onUserInteraction`, `onUnfocus`, `onUserInteractionIfError` | When every field inside checks itself, besides the validate action (Flutter's Form.autovalidateMode). |

<a id="behavior-radioGroup"></a>
### `radioGroup` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [RadioGroupBehavior](forms.md#type-RadioGroupBehavior). Default: unset.

Flutter's RadioGroup: the radios inside share its groupValue; choosing one runs its changed reactions.

<a id="type-RadioGroupBehavior"></a>
#### RadioGroupBehavior

Flutter's `RadioGroup`: the `radio` nodes inside the node that set no `groupValue` of their own share this one, and choosing one of them runs the node's `changed` reactions with its value as `${result}` (`RadioGroup.onChanged`). Bind `groupValue` to the variable the choice is kept in: `"bind": {"radioGroup.groupValue": "${budget}"}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `groupValue` | String | `""` |  | The value of the radio that is on; bind it to the variable the choice is kept in. |

<a id="forms-triggers"></a>
### Triggers

Written as `"trigger": {"type": "<trigger>", ...}` in a reaction ([trigger fields](interaction.md#interaction-trigger-fields)).

| Trigger | When it fires |
|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-changed"></a>`changed` | An input's value changed (typed text, a toggled checkbox, a slider step, a picked item). `${result}` is the new value (a text field's: its text, word and selection). |
| <a id="trigger-changeEnd"></a>`changeEnd` | A slider was let go, with its final value. |
| <a id="trigger-submitted"></a>`submitted` | A text field was submitted from the keyboard. |
| <a id="trigger-deleted"></a>`deleted` | An input chip's delete icon was tapped, or Delete or Backspace pressed on it (Flutter's `onDeleted`). |
| <a id="trigger-editingComplete"></a>`editingComplete` | A text field lost focus after editing. |
| <a id="trigger-focusGained"></a>`focusGained` | A text field gained or lost focus. |
| <a id="trigger-focusLost"></a>`focusLost` |  |
| <a id="trigger-keyDown"></a>`keyDown` | A key went down (or up) while the screen shows; `Trigger.key` limits it to one key or combination, `Trigger.when` to while a formula holds. `${result.key}`, `${result.shift}`, `${result.alt}`, `${result.meta}`. |
| <a id="trigger-keyUp"></a>`keyUp` |  |

<a id="forms-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="forms-styling-the-controls-in-one-place"></a>
### Styling the controls, in one place

| Control | Its look | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `textField` | label, hint, helper and error texts and their styles; border (`"border": {"type": "outline", "borderSide": {"color": ..., "width": 1}, "borderRadius": 8}`), `enabledBorder`, `focusedBorder`, `errorBorder`, `focusedErrorBorder`; `fillColor` + `filled`; `contentPadding`; `prefixIcon` / `suffixIcon`, `prefixText` / `suffixText` | `props.decoration` ([InputDecoration](#type-InputDecoration), [InputBorder](#type-InputBorder), [InputIcon](#type-InputIcon)) |
| `textField` | the typed text's style (`style`), alignment, the caret (`cursorColor`, `showCursor`), the focus ring (`focusRingColor`, `focusRingWidth`) | `props` ([textField](#node-textField)) |
| buttons | `backgroundColor`, `foregroundColor`, `textStyle` (the label's size and weight), `shape` (`{"type": "roundedRectangle", "borderRadius": 10}`), `side` (border), `padding`, `elevation` | `props.style` ([ButtonStyle](#type-ButtonStyle)) |
| `checkbox` | `activeColor`, `checkColor`, `fillColor`, `side` / `activeSide` (the box's border), `borderRadius`, `compact` | `props` ([checkbox](#node-checkbox)) |
| `switch` | `activeTrackColor`, `inactiveTrackColor`, `activeThumbColor`, `inactiveThumbColor`, `fillTrack`, `thumbInset`, `trackOutlineWidth`, `trackRadius` | `props` ([switch](#node-switch)) |
| `radio`, `slider`, `dropdown`, `segmentedButton` | their colours, track and thumb shapes | `props` ([radio](#node-radio), [slider](#node-slider), [dropdown](#node-dropdown), [segmentedButton](#node-segmentedButton)) |
| a labelled row | a `row` holding the control (with `"ignorePointer": true` and its value bound) and a text, with the row's `click` reaction | [a labelled checkbox](#forms-a-labelled-checkbox-or-switch) |

Every colour there may be a theme colour's name; every text style may name a theme style. An outlined or filled
field that sets no `contentPadding` (nor a `layout.padding`) takes Flutter's default, 12 px at the sides, which
keeps its text and label off the border; set `contentPadding` for another.

<a id="forms-a-text-field-bound-to-a-variable-two-way"></a>
### A text field bound to a variable (two-way)

Bind its `props.initialValue` to the variable: `"bind": {"props.initialValue": "${query}"}`. Typing sets the
variable (its `changed` reaction also runs), and setting the variable elsewhere (a clear button, a stepper,
`--set`) changes the text, keeping the caret, as a `TextEditingController` held in state. The other inputs show
their bound value prop (`"bind": {"props.value": "${agree}"}` for a checkbox, switch, slider or dropdown,
`props.selected` for a segmented button, `props.groupValue` for radios) and report a change through `changed`:
store `${result}` in the same variable and the control follows it.

<a id="forms-validation-and-an-error-state"></a>
### Validation and an error state

As Flutter's `TextFormField` and `Form`:

- A field's `validator` is Flutter's `validator: (value) => ...`: an expression that reads the typed text as
  `value` and gives the error to show under the field, or `''` when it is valid:
  `"validator": "${= trim(value) == '' ? 'Enter your name.' : ''}"` (in `props`, not `bind`: it runs on the text
  each time the field checks itself).
- `autovalidateMode` says when a field checks itself (Flutter's `AutovalidateMode`): `disabled` (default: only
  when its form is validated), `onUnfocus` (when the focus leaves it: validate on blur), `onUserInteraction` (as
  it is typed in, once it has been), `onUserInteractionIfError` (as it is typed in, while it shows an error: the
  error clears as soon as it is fixed), `always`. An error stays until the field checks itself again.
- A node with `"form": {"autovalidateMode": ...}` is Flutter's `Form` around the fields inside it: the mode applies
  to all of them, and its nodes read `${form.valid}` (every field passes now) and `${form.errors}` (the errors the
  fields show, top to bottom: `{field, label, message}`) for a summary.
- `{"type": "validate", "node": "<form>"}` is `FormState.validate()`: every field of the form shows its error,
  the first invalid one takes the focus, and `${result}` is whether all are valid, for an `if` that submits.

An error can also come from anywhere else: bind `props.decoration.errorText` (an empty text shows none); the
validator's error, when it shows one, wins. Give a field that may show an error a hug height (`{"hug": 56}`): it
grows by the error line, and the form with it; a fixed height keeps the field that tall. `inputFormatter` applies
only `{"type": "regex", "pattern": ..., "allow": true}`. A form submitted to a service: `submitForm`
([data](data.md#page-data)).

A contact form validated on blur and on send, with a summary of the errors above it, a radio group and a thank-you
that replaces the form:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["contact"],
  "nodes": {
    "contact": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "page"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 760},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "page": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["contactForm", "thanks"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 760}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"crossAxisAlignment": "start", "scrollable": true}
    },
    "contactForm": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["summary", "name", "email", "budgetLabel", "budget", "message", "send"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 560}},
      "props": {"spacing": 14, "crossAxisAlignment": "start"},
      "form": {"autovalidateMode": "onUnfocus"},
      "bind": {"visible": "${= !sent}"}
    },
    "summary": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["summaryTitle", "summaryList"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 60}, "padding": 12},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFEF2F2"}], "strokes": [{"color": "#FFDC2626"}], "radius": 8},
      "props": {"spacing": 4, "crossAxisAlignment": "start"},
      "bind": {"visible": "${= length(form.errors) > 0}"}
    },
    "summaryTitle": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 318}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "", "style": {"fontSize": 15, "fontWeight": 600, "color": "#FF991B1B"}},
      "bind": {
        "props.text": "${= length(form.errors) + (length(form.errors) == 1 ? ' field needs' : ' fields need') + ' attention'}"
      }
    },
    "summaryList": {
      "type": "listView",
      "children": ["summaryItem"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 318}, "height": {"hug": 40}},
      "props": {"scrollable": false, "spacing": 2},
      "bind": {"data": "${form.errors}"}
    },
    "summaryItem": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 318}, "height": {"hug": 18}},
      "props": {"text": "${item.label}: ${item.message}", "style": {"fontSize": 13, "color": "#FF991B1B"}}
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "textField",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 56}},
      "props": {
        "decoration": {"labelText": "Name", "border": {"type": "outline", "borderRadius": 8}},
        "validator": "${= trim(value) == '' ? 'Enter your name.' : ''}"
      },
      "bind": {"props.initialValue": "${name}"}
    },
    "email": {
      "type": "textField",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 56}},
      "props": {
        "keyboardType": "emailAddress",
        "decoration": {"labelText": "Email", "border": {"type": "outline", "borderRadius": 8}},
        "validator": "${= trim(value) == '' ? 'Enter your email.' : !matches(value, '^[^@ ]+@[^@ ]+[.][^@ ]+$') ? 'Enter an email like name@example.com.' : ''}"
      },
      "bind": {"props.initialValue": "${email}"}
    },
    "budgetLabel": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "Budget", "style": {"fontSize": 14, "fontWeight": 600, "color": "#FF111827"}}
    },
    "budget": {
      "type": "row",
      "children": ["budgetSmall", "budgetSmallLabel", "budgetLarge", "budgetLargeLabel"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 32}},
      "props": {"spacing": 8},
      "radioGroup": {"groupValue": "small"},
      "bind": {"radioGroup.groupValue": "${budget}"},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "changed"},
          "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "budget", "value": "${result}"}]
        }
      ]
    },
    "budgetSmall": {"type": "radio", "layout": {"width": 24, "height": 24}, "props": {"value": "small"}},
    "budgetSmallLabel": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 90}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "Under $10k", "style": {"fontSize": 14, "color": "#FF374151"}}
    },
    "budgetLarge": {"type": "radio", "layout": {"width": 24, "height": 24}, "props": {"value": "large"}},
    "budgetLargeLabel": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 90}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "$10k or more", "style": {"fontSize": 14, "color": "#FF374151"}}
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "textField",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 120}},
      "props": {
        "maxLines": 5,
        "minLines": 3,
        "decoration": {"labelText": "Message", "alignLabelWithHint": true, "border": {"type": "outline", "borderRadius": 8}},
        "validator": "${= length(trim(value)) < 20 ? 'Tell us a little more (20 characters or more).' : ''}"
      },
      "bind": {"props.initialValue": "${message}"}
    },
    "send": {
      "type": "filledButton",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 48},
      "props": {"label": "Send message"},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [
            {"type": "validate", "node": "contactForm"},
            {
              "type": "if",
              "condition": {"left": "${result}", "op": "isTrue"},
              "then": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "sent", "value": "${= true}"}]
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    "thanks": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["thanksTitle", "thanksBody"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 80}, "padding": 16},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFF0FDF4"}], "radius": 8},
      "props": {"spacing": 6, "crossAxisAlignment": "start"},
      "bind": {"visible": "${sent}"}
    },
    "thanksTitle": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 310}, "height": {"hug": 24}},
      "props": {"text": "Thanks, ${name}!", "style": {"fontSize": 18, "fontWeight": 700, "color": "#FF166534"}}
    },
    "thanksBody": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 310}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "We'll reply to ${email} within a day.", "style": {"fontSize": 14, "color": "#FF166534"}}
    }
  },
  "variables": {
    "contact": [
      {"name": "name", "type": "text", "value": ""},
      {"name": "email", "type": "text", "value": ""},
      {"name": "budget", "type": "text", "value": "small"},
      {"name": "message", "type": "text", "value": ""},
      {"name": "sent", "type": "boolean", "value": false}
    ]
  }
}
```

<a id="forms-submitting-without-a-backend"></a>
### Submitting without a backend

A site with no service to send to still has a whole submit flow: validate, show a sending state, keep the entry,
confirm, and tell the app that hosts the page. Here a `status` variable (`idle`, `sending`, `error`, `sent`) drives
what shows; the `delay` stands in for the request; `setStorage` keeps every submission on the device (`insert` into
the list `${storage.submissions}`); `emitEvent` hands it to the host app (`codelessly.events`, the same bus a
real backend hook listens on); and the confirmation says plainly that nothing was sent. The success text is honest
about it, so the page is a real offline form, not a mock-up.

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["signup"],
  "nodes": {
    "signup": {"type": "canvas", "slots": {"body": "col"}, "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 420},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}},
    "col": {"type": "column", "children": ["form", "sending", "failed", "sent"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 420}, "padding": 24}, "props": {"spacing": 12}},
    "form": {"type": "column", "children": ["email", "send"], "form": true,
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 120}}, "props": {"spacing": 12},
      "bind": {"visible": "${= status == 'idle' || status == 'error'}"}},
    "email": {"type": "textField", "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 56}},
      "props": {"decoration": {"labelText": "Email"}, "keyboardType": "emailAddress",
        "validator": "${= matches(value, '^[^@ ]+@[^@ ]+[.][^@ ]+$') ? '' : 'Enter an email like name@example.com.'}"},
      "bind": {"props.initialValue": "${email}"},
      "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "changed"}, "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "email", "value": "${result}"}]}]},
    "send": {"type": "filledButton", "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 48}, "props": {"label": "Subscribe"},
      "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"}, "actions": [
        {"type": "validate", "node": "form"},
        {"type": "if", "condition": {"left": "${result}", "op": "isTrue"}, "then": [
          {"type": "setVariable", "variable": "status", "value": "sending"},
          {"type": "delay", "ms": 900},
          {"type": "if", "condition": {"left": "${failNext}", "op": "isTrue"},
            "then": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "status", "value": "error"}],
            "else": [
              {"type": "setStorage", "key": "submissions", "op": "insert", "valueType": "list",
                "value": "${= {'email': email, 'at': now()}}"},
              {"type": "emitEvent", "event": "signupSubmitted", "props": {"email": "${email}"}},
              {"type": "setVariable", "variable": "status", "value": "sent"}]}]}]}]},
    "sending": {"type": "row", "children": ["spinner", "sendingText"], "props": {"spacing": 10},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 32}, "bind": {"visible": "${= status == 'sending'}"}},
    "spinner": {"type": "circularProgressIndicator", "layout": {"width": 24, "height": 24}},
    "sendingText": {"type": "text", "layout": {"width": {"fill": 300}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "Sending…", "style": {"fontSize": 15, "color": "#FF334155"}}},
    "failed": {"type": "text", "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "We couldn't send that. Try again.", "style": {"fontSize": 15, "color": "#FFDC2626"}},
      "bind": {"visible": "${= status == 'error'}"}},
    "sent": {"type": "text", "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "Saved on this device: ${email}. Nothing is sent.", "style": {"fontSize": 15, "color": "#FF166534"}},
      "bind": {"visible": "${= status == 'sent'}"}}
  },
  "variables": {
    "signup": [
      {"name": "email", "type": "text", "value": ""},
      {"name": "status", "type": "text", "value": "idle"},
      {"name": "failNext", "type": "boolean", "value": false}
    ]
  }
}
```

<a id="forms-loading-and-error-states-without-a-backend"></a>
### Loading and error states without a backend

The `status` variable above is the whole loading and error design: one value, a node per state bound to it
(`"visible": "${= status == 'sending'}"`, a spinner and a line; `'error'`, a message over the form, which stays so
the visitor can retry). `failNext` makes the next submit fail, so the error state is exercised by the page itself:
a "simulate a failure" switch in a demo, or the render command's `--set failNext=true --type email=a@b.co --tap
send`. Capture a state mid-flight with `--set 'status="sending"'` (the command settles past a short `delay`). For a
list that loads, the same pattern drives its `loading` and `error` slots from a `status` a `load` reaction sets
after a `delay`.

<a id="forms-a-radio-group"></a>
### A radio group

Flutter's `RadioGroup`: give the node around the radios `"radioGroup": {"groupValue": ...}`, bind its
`radioGroup.groupValue` to the variable that keeps the choice, and store `${result}` in its `changed` reaction. Each
`radio` inside sets only its `value`: it is on when that is the group's value, and choosing it runs the group's
`changed` (and its own). See `budget` in the form above.

<a id="forms-a-stepper-around-a-field"></a>
### A stepper around a field

Two icon buttons that `setVariable` with `"op": "add"` / `"subtract"` on a number, and a field bound two-way to the
same variable. Keep the last valid value in a second variable when the typed text may be invalid.

<a id="forms-a-clear-button-in-the-field"></a>
### A clear button in the field

Its `decoration.suffixIcon` with a tap reaction (`actions` is a list of reactions, as a node's), shown only while
there is text by binding the icon:

```json
"search": {"type": "textField", "layout": {"width": {"fill": 280}, "height": {"hug": 28}},
  "bind": {"props.initialValue": "${query}", "props.decoration.suffixIcon.icon": "${= query == '' ? '' : 'close'}"},
  "props": {"decoration": {"hintText": "Search dishes", "prefixIcon": {"icon": "search", "size": 18}, "suffixIcon": {"icon": "close", "size": 18,
    "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"}, "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "query", "value": ""}]}]}}}}
```

<a id="forms-a-labelled-checkbox-or-switch"></a>
### A labelled checkbox or switch

The whole row toggles: the control ignores the pointer and shows the variable; the row's reaction toggles it. A tap
on a control inside a tappable row otherwise runs the control's own reaction only (the innermost wins).

```json
"agreeRow": {"type": "row", "children": ["agreeBox", "agreeText"], "props": {"spacing": 8},
  "layout": {"width": {"hug": 240}, "height": 40},
  "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"}, "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "agree", "op": "toggle"}]}]},
"agreeBox": {"type": "checkbox", "ignorePointer": true, "layout": {"width": 24, "height": 24}, "bind": {"props.value": "${agree}"}},
"agreeText": {"type": "text", "props": {"text": "I agree", "style": {"fontSize": 15, "color": "#FF111827"}},
  "layout": {"width": {"hug": 60}, "height": {"hug": 20}}}
```

<a id="forms-buttons"></a>
### Buttons

Buttons (`filledButton`, `elevatedButton`, `outlinedButton`, `textButton`, `iconButton`) take `label`, `icon` and
`style`. With no layout they hug: 28 high, padded, the label 12 px unless `style.textStyle.fontSize` says otherwise.
`"loading": true` (bound to a variable an action sets while it runs) shows a spinner in place of the icon and ignores
taps. For full control of a button's look (two lines, an icon after the label), use a `row` with a decoration, padding, text
children, a `click` reaction and [hover and pressed states](interaction.md#interaction-hover-press-and-other-states).

<a id="forms-add-and-remove-items-a-list-editor"></a>
### Add and remove items (a list editor)

Add: `setVariable` on the list with `"op": "add"` (appends; a list value appends each item) and
`"value": "${= object('name', draft, 'done', false)}"`, then clear the draft; guard it with the action's `when` (or
an `if`) on the draft not being empty. Remove: in the item template, `"op": "removeAt"` with `"index": "${index}"`.
Change one item: `"op": "update"` with `index`, or a formula (`${= updateWhere(habits, 'id', item.id, h => set(h,
'done', !h.done))}`). Give items an id (`newId('habit')`) when they can be reordered or removed.

<a id="forms-focus-and-the-keyboard"></a>
### Focus and the keyboard

`focus` moves the focus to a field (or away), `editText` changes its text or selection. `submitted` fires on the
keyboard's done key; `textInputAction` picks the key. A canvas's `keyDown` reaction (`{"trigger": {"type":
"keyDown", "key": "ArrowRight"}, ...}`) runs while no text field has the focus: arrow keys between tabs, Escape to
close. The render command types with `--type <id>=<text>` (it replaces the text) and presses keys with `--key`
(after `--unfocus`).

<a id="forms-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- A button's text is `label`, not `text`; its colours are in `style`, not `decoration`.
- An input does nothing with its value until a `changed` reaction stores it, or its value prop is bound.
- `${result}` in a `changed` chain is the new value until an action that gives a value replaces it; `setVariable`
  does not.
- Every action key is written flat in the action; a misspelled one is dropped (`unknown_action_key`).
- A `validator` reads the field's text as `value`, not the variable the field is bound to; it goes in `props`, not
  `bind`.
- With `autovalidateMode` `disabled` (the default) a validator shows nothing until its form is validated: give the
  form, or the field, a mode, or run `validate` on send.
